description: Browse the public social graph of an account through the AppView. Requires directory.read. Read-only; no follow, block or list mutation is exposed. Requires a service JWT obtained from the caller PDS (com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth) with aud set to the admin service DID and lxm set to the invoked method.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the permission for this method.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The AppView client is not configured.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: The account is not known to the AppView.

errors.name: UpstreamUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView is unreachable or timed out.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: The AppView rate limited the request.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The requested graph kind is not supported.
